verdict.rationale: Fly.io provides compute building blocks that can host background work: Sprites give agents a persistent Linux box that sleeps until woken on request, and Machines have restart policies. However, the evidence shows no first-party automation feature such as schedules, triggers or recurring jobs. Community evidence notes that cron-like scheduled tasks are missing and users must run their own permanent scheduler app, which is a user-side workaround. Hosting an agent or process is a developer building block, not the automation capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
